data.title: What is Tailwind CSS?
data.content: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework used to build custom user interfaces quickly by applying pre-defined, low-level classes directly into HTML markup.

data.title: Why use TypeScript with React?
data.content: TypeScript adds static type definitions to Javascript. It helps catch errors early, offers better autocompletion in your IDE, and makes your component contracts highly predictable.

data.title: How does the animation work?
data.content: Instead of mapping max-height (which causes jumpy layout flashes), this component uses Tailwind's grid-rows properties grid-rows-[0fr] and grid-rows-[1fr] combined with transition-all to create a perfectly fluid height transition.
